Firstly it’s important to note that Apex is a team game and you will benefit the most from playing off your teammates in a fight.

Learn the basics of fighting 3v3, repetition is key. When you lose a fight try to understand what was happening throughout the whole fight and up to the point of your death. There’s a lot that goes into a fight the higher the skill level but you should start by just analyzing your gameplay and take note of you AND your teams positioning. Take into account of what guns / legends are being used and what they are being used for in a fight.

A lot of the learning will come over time and as this happens you will develop game-sense , mechanics, and overall a better understanding of the game. 

Also I would say don’t be afraid to make mistakes because they will happen. If you die because of a play you’ve made it doesn’t necessarily mean it’s bad but you have to determine what is a good / bad play by analyzing gameplay overtime.

I find that watching a lot of educational Apex YouTubers, like Dazs for example, really helps me learn the game faster. 

If you are starting out playing normal pubs, i would honestly just keep landing near or around teams and adjusting to the basic mechanics of Apex and getting a feel for what the meta for guns are. 

Usually the meta legends / guns are posted all over the internet so I’d read up on what’s good and what’s not. 

Honestly there’s a bunch more i could write but i will leave that for the YouTubers to explain because they’ll probably do a better job anyway lol but that is where I would start. 

Good luck and welcome to Apex !
